summary: This round adds two changes. Installing a template now abandons the copy when the recipient's workspace refuses its reference, for example because a stopped local project already uses the name: it removes the copy's VM and deletes the record, so a later retry starts clean. A snapshot without data now reads source and build without stopping the running app, so the author's live app keeps serving while a template is published. The abandon path is tested (error text, empty app list, one VM removed, retry succeeds); all temp tests pass, every changed line is covered or validly exempt, and no findings remain.
